hash_note: SHA-256 of the records file with CRLF normalised to LF, so Windows and Linux checkouts agree.

prepared.method: Evidence span copied verbatim from the live corpus chunk named in each record; content hash recomputed from that chunk.

use_in_application: None until status is APPROVED with approved_by and approved_at set. Once approved, a CONTRAINDICATED or MAJOR record raises the live risk tier to R3 and gives the named chunk a relationship identity for claim verification. Records never lower a tier.
verification_required_before_approval: The source chunk's document_url is a placeholder (setid=example-simvastatin). Confirm the evidence span against the current DailyMed prescribing information for simvastatin.
Confirm the RxCUIs with RxNav: 36567 (simvastatin) and 21212 (clarithromycin). They come from the project's test fixtures; rxnav.nlm.nih.gov was not reachable when this candidate was prepared.
Confirm predicate CONTRAINDICATION, severity CONTRAINDICATED and direction A_TO_B (subject simvastatin).
how_to_approve: Set status to APPROVED and approval to {"approved_by": "<name>", "approved_at": "<YYYY-MM-DD>"}. Any edit to the records file needs a new records_sha256.
frozen_data_note: LIVE_MEDICAL_CORPUS_V2 and research datasets are not modified; this is a separate versioned dataset.

verification_2026_10_14.method: DailyMed label pages and RxNav properties read through Claude's web reader (model-mediated, short quotes, not byte-exact). Direct access from the cloud and device environments was refused by network policy.
verification_2026_10_14.rxcuis: RxNav properties: 36567 = simvastatin (TTY IN, not suppressed); 21212 = clarithromycin (TTY IN, not suppressed). Byte-exact capture pending.
verification_2026_10_14.relationship: Supported in content by both labels: simvastatin (ZOCOR, setid 8f55d5de-5a4f-4a39-8c84-c53976dd6af9) contraindicates strong CYP3A4 inhibitors and lists clarithromycin among them; clarithromycin (setid 9aaffb41-408c-4372-8fd5-1d649450c0e9) section 4.5 contraindicates co-administration with simvastatin. Both directions, so BIDIRECTIONAL rather than A_TO_B.
verification_2026_10_14.provenance_finding: The source chunk DAILYMED-SPL-SIMVASTATIN-001-CHUNK-01 is not a verbatim excerpt of any label checked, and its document_url is a placeholder, so this record's evidence cannot be linked to an authoritative document.
verification_2026_10_14.recommendation: Do not approve V1. Capture the labels byte for byte (scripts/capture_live_relationship_sources.py) and prepare a V2 candidate from the captured text.
